source_evidence: Player exact 'Ok we will pursue a hereditary recovery grant' accepts the previously explained conditional grant path. Competent officer obtains ordinary countersignature and issues recorded written conditional authority in actual play, without additional contrived administrative barrier; parcel boundary confirmation remains a substantive condition before title. No new unapproved terms or expenditure. Original accepted offer terms in prior chunk control. D326~10:25 Orsaven royal land-records office, V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar together; coach/four horses safely at Copper Hart. V expressly elects to pursue hereditary recovery grant for the western Ossent abandoned service house. Crown land-disposition officer prepares the written conditional instrument on the previously offered terms, obtains ordinary competent Crown countersignature and records V's acceptance; V receives the signed conditional recovery instrument and registrar retains official counterpart. Scope is the registered Crown-held abandoned service house and immediate disused grounds associated with the collapsed crossing depicted in authenticated survey; exact acreage/boundary to be verified in ordinary site inspection before deed. Instrument authorizes lawful inspection/reclamation of Crown-held parcel subject to existing household/public rights, and commits issuance of hereditary deed upon fulfillment: secure actual hazards by removal/containment/safe isolation; protect ferrier household dwelling, access, landing and return-channel usage, remedy damage directly caused by recovery; confirm parcel and actual safety/access conditions through competent Crown inspection or adequate evidence. Zero purchase price, deposit, bond, rent, mandatory full rebuilding, minimum capital investment, Crown service or fixed completion deadline. Ordinary applicable taxes/law after acquisition; no special exemptions, water monopoly, toll authority, forced tenancy or title to disputed artifacts or occupied dwelling. Routine officials handle recording; no arbitrary repeat gate. This is an accepted conditional recovery grant, NOT present ownership or completed reclamation, no deed until conditions met. No fee, property purchase, expedition departure, roll or restoration contract. V controls subsequent expedition timing and choices. All party resources full after D326 long rest: V48/48 AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1 cloak+Luckstone attuned; Cirren51/51 AC19 HD6/6 slots4/3/3 CD2/2 +1 Shield equipped, old shield retained, Boots of Elvenkind; Fenar59/59 AC16 HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 inactive MP6/6 CLIMB40, breastplate and Insignia of Claws, natural attacks+9/1d6+6 base or1d6+8 raging, mechanical greataxe unchanged; Mara and horses healthy. Purse2049gp8sp6cp, rations21/feed28, LR0/6. Coris evidence packet in keeper's outgoing custody via Edric; dispatch/receipt/300gp assessment pending; Mara retains authenticated survey, western crossing 48 road+12 rough miles (~3 days each way), optional800gp field milestone unearned. Diplomatic invitation delivered D325, receipt and credentials held, Crown reply pending; separate frontier inquiry300+1300 contingent. Ferrymen's Share boatyard inquiry available; Quenwood life imprisonment upheld, restitution not paid. Both magic commissions accepted, deposits260gp already paid, balance520gp due upon completion target353; Serpent Dart unresolved. Elara Caereth, Severin assent unconfirmed, Kestrel custody unchanged. V dice delegated until stopped. Await next activity; no automatic departure, purchase, new NPC reply or further commitment.
